title: Selling Plans Chargeback Administration Fee Rates
content:
The administration fee withheld from a chargeback credit on **Selling Plans** is charged at a rate that depends on two records: the number of chargeback debits on the seller's Northloop Payments account, and the seller's performance level on the Seller Performance Standing record.

**Rule.** The chargeback administration fee rate is the low chargeback admin rate when the payments account shows no more than the few-chargebacks count of chargeback debits dated less than twelve whole months before the decision date and the seller's performance level is one of the discount standing levels, the mid chargeback admin rate when the account shows no more than that count and the level is Above Standard Level, and the refund administration fee rate otherwise.

The discount standing levels are Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level. The count takes every chargeback debit on the payments account dated less than twelve whole months before the decision date, on any order.

## Rate matrix

| Chargeback debits on the Northloop Payments account, last twelve whole months | Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | Above Standard Level | Any other level |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 or fewer (the few-chargebacks count) | 10% (low chargeback admin rate) | 15% (mid chargeback admin rate) | The plan's refund administration fee rate |
| 2 or more | The plan's refund administration fee rate | The plan's refund administration fee rate | The plan's refund administration fee rate |

## Cases (hypothetical records)

- One chargeback debit in the last twelve whole months, Top Rated Level → 10%.
- Two chargeback debits, Preferred Partner Level → the plan's refund administration fee rate.
- One chargeback debit, Above Standard Level → 15%.
